def load_grids():

    # The session file is in the folder

        pattern = r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n'
        match = re.search(pattern, content)
        
        while match:
            key = match.group(1)
            h, w = int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
            
            # Extract grid rows
            start = match.end()
            lines = content[start:start+h].strip().split('\n')

                grid = [[int(x) for x in line] for line in lines]
                G[key] = grid
            
            # Find next match
            match = re.search(pattern, content[match.end():])
    
    return G
